findings.description: Reusing the wrapper's statistics dictionary makes overlapping invocations overwrite each other's active statistics. The same change also removes invocation isolation in the synchronous wrapper.
findings.rationale: Start invocation A, let its first attempt fail and enter a retry sleep, then run invocation B of the same decorated function successfully before A resumes. B clears and initializes the dictionary that A's retry object also uses, resetting attempt_number to 1. When A succeeds on its second attempt, its statistics incorrectly report one attempt; callbacks inspecting A's retry object also see B's statistics. Previously each invocation's copy retained its own dictionary.
